customer_message: I don't understand the difference between Freehold and Leasehold
expected_response: In simple terms: Freehold gives you 100% permanent ownership of the property and land forever. Leasehold gives you rights to use the property for a long period (typically 30 to 99 years), but not the underlying land.

customer_message: What does off-plan actually mean? Is the building not built yet?
expected_response: Exactly! Off-plan means purchasing a property before or during its construction, directly from the developer based on architectural plans and 3D renderings.

customer_message: Everyone talks about DLD fees, what even is that?
expected_response: DLD stands for Dubai Land Department. The DLD fee is a 4% one-time government registration tax paid during a property purchase to issue your official Title Deed.

customer_message: Can a foreign expat actually own 100% of a property in Dubai?
expected_response: Yes, 100%! Since 2002, foreigners of any nationality can purchase and own 100% freehold property in designated freehold zones across Dubai without needing a local partner.

customer_message: Why are there service charges if I already own the flat?
expected_response: Even though you own your individual flat, the building has shared areas like elevators, security, swimming pool, gym, and facade cleaning. Service charges fund the upkeep of those shared amenities.

customer_message: What is an Ejari? Is it a contract or a government office?
expected_response: 'Ejari' is an Arabic word meaning 'My Rent'. In Dubai, it refers to the mandatory online system managed by the Land Department to officially register all rental contracts legally.

customer_message: What is the difference between RERA and DLD?
expected_response: Think of DLD (Dubai Land Department) as the government ministry overseeing all real estate, while RERA (Real Estate Regulatory Agency) is the executive arm that sets rules, licenses agents, and enforces laws.

customer_message: What is an Escrow account and why does everyone ask about it?
expected_response: An escrow account is a protected bank account where your payments for off-plan property are held. The developer cannot withdraw the funds until they achieve verified construction milestones.

customer_message: How does a Golden Visa connect to buying property?
expected_response: If you buy property worth AED 2 million or more in Dubai, you become eligible for a 10-year renewable UAE Golden Residency Visa for yourself and your family.

customer_message: What is Form F / Memorandum of Understanding (MOU)?
expected_response: Form F (also known as the MOU) is the official standard purchase contract between buyer and seller in Dubai. It details price, timeline, deposits, and conditions.

customer_message: What is an NOC in real estate?
expected_response: NOC stands for 'No Objection Certificate'. It's a document issued by the master developer confirming all service charges and debts are clear, allowing ownership transfer.

customer_message: What is the RERA Rental Calculator?
expected_response: It's an official online tool from RERA that calculates whether a landlord is legally permitted to increase your rent at renewal, and caps the maximum allowed percentage.

customer_message: What does Chiller Free mean?
expected_response: In Dubai, air conditioning can be billed separately. 'Chiller Free' means the landlord or building covers the air conditioning cooling costs, so you only pay for your normal household electricity.

customer_message: Is handover the same thing as moving in?
expected_response: Handover is when you inspect the unit, receive the keys, and obtain the completion certificate. You can move in immediately after, once DEWA (electricity/water) is activated.

customer_message: What is a snagging inspection?
expected_response: Snagging is a thorough technical inspection of a newly built property to identify defects, paint scratches, plumbing issues, or misaligned doors before you formally accept keys.

customer_message: What is ROI and how is gross yield different from net yield?
expected_response: Gross yield is annual rental income divided by purchase price. Net yield subtracts annual service charges, maintenance, and management fees to show your true profit in hand.

customer_message: What does post-handover payment plan mean?
expected_response: It means you receive the keys and can live in or rent out the property while continuing to pay off remaining installments to the developer over 2 to 5 years without a bank mortgage.

customer_message: What is DEWA?
expected_response: DEWA stands for Dubai Electricity and Water Authority. It's the government utility provider that supplies power and water to all Dubai residences.

customer_message: Can I buy a property with crypto?
expected_response: Yes, many developers and licensed brokers accept crypto! Legally, the crypto is converted into UAE Dirhams through a licensed exchange before transfer to developer escrow.

customer_message: What is an Oqood certificate?
expected_response: 'Oqood' is the pre-title deed issued by DLD for properties under construction. Once construction finishes, Oqood automatically converts into a final Title Deed.

customer_message: What does turnkey property mean?
expected_response: Turnkey means a property is 100% complete, fully furnished, equipped with appliances, and ready for you to turn the key and live in or rent out on day one.

customer_message: What is a mortgage pre-approval versus final approval?
expected_response: Pre-approval is a bank's initial commitment of how much they will lend based on your salary. Final approval happens after the bank appraises the specific property you chose.

customer_message: Why do some apartments have 1 bedroom and 2 bathrooms?
expected_response: In Dubai, most 1-bedroom apartments feature an en-suite bathroom inside the bedroom plus a separate powder room (guest toilet) off the living area for visitors.

customer_message: What is a secondary market property versus primary market?
expected_response: Primary market means buying brand new directly from the developer. Secondary market means buying a resale property from an existing individual owner.

customer_message: What is an SPA?
expected_response: SPA stands for 'Sales and Purchase Agreement'. It's the comprehensive legal contract between you and the developer detailing specifications, payment dates, and warranties.

customer_message: What is the difference between built-up area and carpet area?
expected_response: Carpet area is the actual usable floor area inside your walls. Built-up area (BUA) includes the thickness of internal and external walls plus balconies.

customer_message: What does distress sale mean in Dubai?
expected_response: A distress sale occurs when an owner needs immediate cash liquidity and lists their property below market value for a fast, all-cash closing.

customer_message: What is a PDC (Post-Dated Cheque)?
expected_response: In UAE rentals, tenants traditionally provide signed cheques dated for future dates (e.g. 1, 2, or 4 cheques a year) which the landlord deposits on those specific dates.

customer_message: Why is there both an agency fee and a transfer fee?
expected_response: Agency fee (usually 2%) pays for the broker's search, negotiations, and transaction coordination. Transfer fee (4%) is paid strictly to the Dubai Land Department to register legal title.

customer_message: What is a mezzanine floor?
expected_response: A mezzanine is an intermediate low-ceiling floor between the ground floor and the first residential floor, often housing amenities, offices, or facilities.

customer_message: What is a duplex vs a penthouse?
expected_response: A duplex is any apartment spanning two interconnected levels with internal stairs. A penthouse sits on the highest floor of a tower, usually offering expansive terraces and views.

customer_message: Can I rent out my apartment on Airbnb legally in Dubai?
expected_response: Yes, completely legal! Dubai has an official 'Holiday Homes' framework through the Department of Economy and Tourism (DET) where you or an operator register the unit.

customer_message: What is the Dubai REST App?
expected_response: Dubai REST is the official Dubai Land Department mobile app. Owners, tenants, and buyers can verify title deeds, check escrow status, and view rental indices there.

customer_message: What is a townhouse vs a villa?
expected_response: A standalone villa has no shared walls and sits on its own private plot. A townhouse shares one or two side walls with neighboring units in a row.

customer_message: What happens if I cannot pay an installment on an off-plan property?
expected_response: Developers offer grace periods and restructuring. If prolonged, RERA follows a formal mediation and notification process before any cancellation can legally happen.

expected_response: 'Secondary' does not mean second-rate! It simply means buying an existing resale property from an individual owner, rather than buying off-plan directly from the developer.

customer_message: Can you clarify what happens to my deposit if my mortgage fails?
expected_response: If we include a standard 'Subject to Mortgage' clause in Form F, your 10% security deposit is legally protected and returned if the bank appraisal fails through no fault of your own.

customer_message: What is a developer NOC and why is it needed?
expected_response: The No Objection Certificate (NOC) is issued by the master developer to certify that the seller has settled all service charges and debts, legally clearing the path for the title transfer to you.

customer_message: What is the difference between a studio and a 1-bedroom?
expected_response: A studio is a single open-plan room combining the living, sleeping, and kitchen spaces with a separate bathroom. A 1-bedroom has a dedicated bedroom separated by a wall and door from the living room.

customer_message: Does 'chiller included' cover electricity?
expected_response: No—chiller only covers the cooling consumption of the AC. Your standard electricity (lights, TV, washing machine, fridge) is billed separately through your monthly DEWA account.

customer_message: What is an expat versus a non-resident buyer?
expected_response: An expat is a foreign national living and working in the UAE on a residency visa. A non-resident is an international buyer or tourist living abroad who purchases property in Dubai remotely or on holiday.

customer_message: What does 'high floor' typically mean in Dubai towers?
expected_response: In a typical 40-to-60 story Dubai skyscraper, 'low floor' is 1-15, 'mid floor' is 16-35, and 'high floor' is 36 and above, offering open horizons and reduced street noise.

customer_message: What does 'shell and core' mean?
expected_response: Shell and core means the space is delivered as raw concrete with basic structural utility connections—giving you complete freedom to design your own flooring, walls, lighting, and layout from scratch.

customer_message: What is a powder room?
expected_response: A powder room is a guest half-bathroom containing a toilet and washbasin, located near the living or dining room so visiting guests don't have to enter your private bedroom.

customer_message: What does ROI mean in practical terms?
expected_response: ROI stands for 'Return on Investment'. In practical terms, it tells you what percentage of your purchase money you make back each year from rental income and property value growth.

customer_message: Can you clarify if off-plan prices are negotiable?
expected_response: Developer headline prices on off-plan are generally fixed across tiers, but developers frequently offer incentives like waived 4% DLD fees, complimentary furniture vouchers, or more relaxed payment plans!

customer_message: What is Ejari cancellation?
expected_response: Ejari cancellation is the formal deregistration of a tenancy contract when a tenant moves out. It is required before a new tenant or owner can activate a fresh Ejari and DEWA connection.

customer_message: What does 'motivated seller' actually mean?
expected_response: 'Motivated seller' usually means the owner is relocating, restructuring debts, or needs quick liquidity, making them much more open to negotiating below their initial asking price.

customer_message: Does buying a property automatically give me a work permit?
expected_response: A property Golden Visa gives you legal residency and independence to live in Dubai, but to work for an employer, the employer issues your work permit, or you can obtain a freelance/independent permit.

customer_message: What is a mezzanine level in an apartment building?
expected_response: A mezzanine is an intermediate low-floor level located between the ground lobby and first residential floor, typically housing retail shops, gyms, spas, or building management offices.

customer_message: What is the difference between built-up area and plot area for a villa?
expected_response: Plot area is the total size of the land your property sits on (including garden and driveway). Built-up area (BUA) is the actual indoor living space across all floors inside the walls.

customer_message: What does 'chiller on tenant' mean on a listing?
expected_response: It means the tenant must set up an account with the district cooling provider (like Empower or Emicool) and pay monthly air conditioning consumption bills in addition to rent.

customer_message: What does 'distress deal' mean in Dubai?
expected_response: In true terms, it's a seller who must liquidate an asset rapidly due to cash needs, pricing the unit 10% to 20% below current market transactions for an all-cash buyer.

customer_message: Can you clarify what happens if a cheque bounces in the UAE?
expected_response: Under updated UAE commercial laws, bounced cheques are decriminalized for most commercial/rental transactions, transitioning to civil enforcement and financial penalties through the courts.

customer_message: What is the difference between a townhouse and a semi-detached villa?
expected_response: A townhouse is part of a continuous row of 3 or more attached homes. A semi-detached villa is joined to only one other home on one side, leaving three sides open to private gardens and light.

customer_message: If I take a mortgage, will rising interest rates hurt my monthly budget?

customer_message: How much should I realistically budget for annual maintenance on a villa?

customer_message: What happens if my tenant stops paying rent in Dubai?
